item.title: NetworkManager VPN plug-ins: Fix critical vulnerabilities
item.description:
As reported by https://blogs.gnome.org/mcatanzaro/2026/09/15/privilege-escalation-vulnerabilities-in-networkmanager-plugins/, several NetworkManager VPN plug-ins are affected by a serious local privilege escalation vulnerability.

  • Two of them (fortisslvpn and vpnc) are abandoned upstream and alternatives exist so we are removing them.
  • The proposed replacement for networkmanager-vpnc was not actually packaged so I am introducing networkmanager-libreswan.
  • sstp is unmaintained and no patch exists but does not have a replacement so marking it as insecure.
  • iodine has a patch proposed, vendoring it until it is merged.

Due to the seriousness of the vulnerability I propose backporting the removals:

You are vulnerable if you have the VPN plugin installed; it does not matter whether you actually use it or not.
